coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from Missing Major Aspect, the highest severity error for broad coverage. consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses exhibit the same high‑severity internal‑consistency failures: each contains unresolved conflicts (contradictory claims about whether a single metric set can determine product‑market fit) and blurred viewpoints/conflation (mixing distinct measurement frameworks and authors without clear separation).
